pages.text: Julisium Petals, originally made by the prince of Lust to assist in other-worldly travel, can also be used against the princes in order to bound them to a padlock and utilize their powers for the user.

Julisium Petals are used mainly for creating bound padlocks, which provide the user different enhancements and abilities. This ranges anywhere from additional health to increased movement speed or luck values.
These entries may also be useful in your studies.
